summary: Cloud CRM for managing leads, accounts, opportunities, and service cases, with a broad platform API.
access_note: Free Developer Edition org and External Client Apps created in Setup (not verified from vendor docs: developer.salesforce.com returned 403 to automated fetches). Hosted MCP servers must be activated by an org admin.
blocker_note: Each customer org admin must create an External Client App and enable the hosted MCP servers; hosted MCP is billed via Flex Credits per search snippets (unverified).

evidence.quote: Connected Apps are a legacy construct and are not supported for MCP authentication.
If the user can't do it in the Lightning UI or via the REST API, they can't do it via MCP.
The processing of the MCP server is completely deterministic.

notes: developer.salesforce.com blocks automated fetches (HTTP 403), so evidence comes only from the vendor-owned forcedotcom GitHub wiki FAQ. Free Developer Edition, SOAP and GraphQL APIs, and Flex Credits billing are from search result snippets or general knowledge, not a fetched page. Hosted MCP guide URL is from search results.
